question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58c2d53582945d59fe775c5bee9b3f92c9de0b99902da4a706d9efdabb824120.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The shape rotates 90 degrees in the clockwise direction and one triangle is added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e2586226f619103523fc00f37e07b599bd81432f5bc5e7c74a177a112064890.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The shape rotates 90 degrees in the clockwise direction and one triangle is added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e52a01e34ff80fbc4360cc6493fa83719a19a7188631e0d5198c0cc23b271db.png] 

**From Figure (3) to Answer Figure (4):**

The shape rotates 90 degrees in the clockwise direction and one triangle is added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/959b6cb0b3f79e9a0aa229c9fe52d1f49af10d6e696fa46d3cbf182a4416da11.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (2)".**
